output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, the latest Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Form 13F I identified is for Q2 2026, covering holdings as of June 30 and filed August 14. It reported $299,253,556,246 in value across 89 information-table entries; a holdings tracker presents 29 positions. The ten largest by reported value were Apple ($66.0B; 227,917,808 shares), American Express ($51.3B; 151,610,700), Coca-Cola ($32.5B; 400,000,000), Alphabet Class A ($28.2B; 78,791,167), Bank of America ($27.5B; 483,394,015), Chevron ($14.0B; 84,375,856), Occidental Petroleum ($12.9B; 264,941,431), Chubb ($11.7B; 34,249,183), Moody’s ($11.2B; 24,669,778), and Alphabet Class C ($9.61B; 27,188,433). Other listed holdings include Ally Financial, Capital One, D.R. Horton, DaVita, Delta Air Lines, Jefferies Financial Group, Kraft Heinz, Kroger, Lennar (Class A and B), Liberty Live (Class A and C), Louisiana-Pacific, Macy’s, NVR, New York Times, Nucor, Sirius XM, and VeriSign.
caveats: These are quarter-end disclosed positions, not necessarily Berkshire’s current holdings; 13F reporting is limited and does not show the full portfolio. The tracker notes that 13Fs omit short positions, cash, bonds, most non-U.S. holdings, and trades made after quarter-end.
A November 5 article said the next 13F was expected November 16, 2026, so the Q2 filing was the latest one identified as of November 11; that expected date is not confirmation of a later filing.
